title: A Comment on an Essay
transcript:
Student: Hi, I have an appointment at three. It's for my history essay.
Tutor: Great, have a seat. What would you like to focus on?
Student: My professor said my argument gets lost in the middle. I'm not sure what she means.
Tutor: Let's look. Okay, see these two paragraphs? They're interesting, but they don't connect back to your thesis.
Student: So should I cut them?
Tutor: Not necessarily. Try adding a sentence to each that ties it to your main point. Then read it again.
Student: That sounds doable.
